title: CKPE (Creation Kit Platform Extended): what it is and how to install it
content:
CKPE (Creation Kit Platform Extended): what it is and how to install it
CKPE by perchik71 patches the Fallout 4 Creation Kit at runtime: dozens of crash fixes, a replacement memory manager, faster loading, extra windows and options. It is the successor of the older FO4 CKFixes. Nexus #51165; the README directs downloads to the GitHub releases.
Install: pick the build for your CPU, Regular (AVX2) or No AVX2 (Steam > Help > System Information > Processor Information says whether AVX2 is supported). Extract every file into the Fallout 4 root folder next to CreationKit.exe. A current install has ckpe_loader.exe, CKPE.dll, CKPE.Common.dll, CKPE.Fallout4.dll and CKPE.PluginAPI.dll there, plus the settings file CreationKitPlatformExtended.toml (older CKPE builds used CreationKitPlatformExtended.dll and an .ini). It also needs its address library, see "CKPE address library".
tags: ckpe creation-kit install avx2 ckpe_loader toml nexus-51165

title: Which CKPE for which Creation Kit version: one current build covers them all
content:
Which CKPE for which Creation Kit version: one current build covers them all
One current CKPE build (0.6) supports every Fallout 4 Creation Kit version: 1.10.162.0 (the OG CK), 1.10.943.1, 1.10.982.3 (the Next-Gen CK), 1.11.137.0, 1.11.240.0 and 1.11.246.0. There is no longer a separate CKPE per CK version; use the latest CKPE.
Older advice such as "CKPE 0.3 for OG, 0.5 for NG" describes old releases. What does have to match your CK version is the address library file in CKPEBins.
Check your CK version: CreationKit.exe file version, or the first lines of the CKPE log ("CK: 1.11 build 246 rev:0" means 1.11.246.0).
tags: ckpe creation-kit version og ng 1.10.162 1.10.982 1.11.246 compatibility

Log header format from a real CKPE 0.6 build 267 install next to Creation Kit 1.11.246.0.

title: CKPE address library (CKPEBins): required for your exact CK version
content:
CKPE address library (CKPEBins): required for your exact CK version
CKPE needs an address library file for your exact Creation Kit version, in the Fallout 4 folder: CKPEBins\version-<CK version with dashes>.bin, for example CKPEBins\version-1-11-246-0.bin for CK 1.11.246.0. It comes with the CKPE download from Nexus #51165 (Vortex installs it automatically) and is also in the CKPE GitHub repository under Database/FO4/CKPEBins.
If the file for your CK version is missing, CKPE cannot patch the Creation Kit and logs: IDDatabase::Load file "...CKPEBins\version-....bin" no found. After a CK update, check that a .bin for the new version exists.

title: Where CKPE's logs and crash dumps are
content:
Where CKPE's logs and crash dumps are
CKPE writes its log to Fallout 4\Logs\CKPE\CreationKitPlatformExtended.log. With [Log] sOutputFile = "ckpe.log" in CreationKitPlatformExtended.toml it also copies it to Fallout 4\ckpe.log. The log starts with the CK, CKPE runtime, Common library and game library versions, and how many patches were applied.
When CK crashes, CKPE writes a crash dump (bGenerateCrashdumps, default on) into Fallout 4\Logs\CKPE\Crashes. [Crashes] bGenerateFullDump makes a larger dump with more detail, which includes personal information; it is for opening yourself in WinDbg.
Mossy's CK Tools Hub > CKPE Diagnostics reads these files.

title: CKPE and precombines / previs: -GeneratePreCombined and bInstallOnlyModeCLI
content:
CKPE and precombines / previs: -GeneratePreCombined and bInstallOnlyModeCLI
CKPE has a precombine patch that its own settings file says is harmful to previs. So by default ([PreCombined] bInstallOnlyModeCLI = true) the patch is installed only when the Creation Kit is started from the command line with -GeneratePreCombined, which is how precombine tools such as the PJM scripts run it. Setting bInstallOnlyModeCLI = false installs it every time.
[PreCombined] bGenerateForPC (default true) controls the Havok collision output of precombining for PC; false means PS4 mode, where the patch is not needed.
When CK runs with -GeneratePreVisData, CKPE skips loading textures.
CKPE's PreVis patch fixes a crash where the visibility step got a form that is not a cell.

title: Saving .esm masters in the Creation Kit with CKPE: bAllowSaveESM and bAllowMasterESP
content:
Saving .esm masters in the Creation Kit with CKPE: bAllowSaveESM and bAllowMasterESP
Vanilla CK refuses to save a master file ("File is a master file or is in use") and cannot use an ESP as a master. CKPE can change both:
- [CreationKit] bAllowSaveESM (default false): lets CK save .esm files directly and set them as the Active File. CKPE warns this destroys version-control information. It only takes effect when CK's version control is off.
- [CreationKit] bAllowMasterESP (default false): lets .esp files act as masters for the plugin being saved.
CKPE's own FAQ notes that on old builds (before 0.4 build 625) turning bAllowSaveESM off fixed "cannot save a mod" problems.

title: Faster Creation Kit loading with CKPE: topic validation and animation data
content:
Faster Creation Kit loading with CKPE: topic validation and animation data
Two CKPE settings speed up loading plugins in the Creation Kit:
- [CreationKit] bSkipTopicInfoValidation: skips dialogue Topic Info validation during load. CKPE's settings file recommends it ("fix crashes") and says it does not matter when form validation is disabled.
- [Animation] bSkipAnimationBuildData (default false): skips building animation data, which makes loading much faster. Turn it off when you are working on animations, or CK will not have that data.
CKPE also applies a general load optimisation patch (OptimizationLoad) and replaces CK's memory manager and scrap heap (MemoryManager).

title: What crashes CKPE fixes in the Fallout 4 Creation Kit (and what it does not)
content:
What crashes CKPE fixes in the Fallout 4 Creation Kit (and what it does not)
Crash and hang fixes in CKPE's Fallout 4 patches (patch names from its source): the infinite loop in the Compile Papyrus Scripts dialog (FixInfiniteLoopPapyrusCompile); a crash when a plugins.txt is in the game root folder (FixPluginTXT); a PreVis crash (PreVis); Havok rigid body crash (HavokRigidBodyCrash); a sorting crash in combined lists (SortCrashCombined); invalid strings (CrashInvalidStrings); the MapMarker command line option (FixCrashMapMarkerCmd); materials with no root parent (FixCrashNoRootMat); spell effect duration (FixCrashSpellEaxDur); tab delete (FixTabDeleteCrash); Unicode BNet strings (FixBNet); GetCrime condition items. It also raises the SNAM chunk size from 512 to 2048.
CKPE has no navmesh-specific crash fix: its NavMesh Window patch only changes the window. For navmesh crashes, check the plugin itself (deleted NAVM records in xEdit, overlapping triangles).
[CreationKit] bDisableAssertions hides CK's error pop-ups; CKPE does not recommend it because real problems go unnoticed.

title: CK reference limit and CKPE's bBSPointerHandleExtremly
content:
CK reference limit and CKPE's bBSPointerHandleExtremly
The Creation Kit has a fixed number of reference handles; very large worldspace edits or precombine runs can run out ("ran out of Reference Handles"). CKPE replaces CK's handle manager, and its experimental [CreationKit] bBSPointerHandleExtremly option (default false) raises the maximum number of references to 67,108,864 (8,388,608 for NG2, per CKPE's settings comment). CKPE marks it "use at your own risk".
